note: Fayette County Conservation's 64-acre park at the confluence of the Little Turkey River and Crane Creek, 5 mi north of Hawkeye; the electric sites sit on open lawn inside a bend of the Little Turkey, with primitive sites across the river on the south side. On-site resident host. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15-20 (undated), 29 electric sites, bathhouse with showers, dump. Added water hookups, pit toilets, water hydrants. Riverfront stands: south-row RVs 30-40 m from the bank across open lawn; channel ~29-35 m.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront stands (width at the line): the camp sits on open lawn inside a bend of the Little Turkey River. On Esri (0.22 m/px) the south row of RVs is ~30-40 m from the bank with no road, trees or day use between, and the channel beside it measures ~29 m at the south bend and ~35 m on the west reach, right at the ~30 m river line. Crane Creek (the confluence) is not beside the pads in the frame. Northern sites, behind a belt of trees by the shelter road, are not on the water.
HOOKUPS water true from 'Electric & water hookups are available here' (MyCountyParks); the same page also lists 'Water Refill Hydrants', so some sites may rely on hydrants. Amperage not posted.
FEES undated on the county page; rate unchanged.
SEASON: MyCountyParks says 'Open year round' only under park hours (6 AM-10:30 PM); not a campground statement, so season left unset.
BOOKING not stated on either page (no MyCountyParks bookable facility seen). Left unset.
PIN OK (~40 m from the RV cluster). Website and phone 563-425-3613 as stored; the county site lists the main office as 563-422-5146.
